en-US.title: Bolo: Speak Hindi
en-US.subtitle: Real-life conversation skills
en-US.description:
Practice Hindi for the moments that happen in real life.

Bolo helps you move from recognizing words to choosing a natural response. Work through 102 short lessons in 11 guided plans, plus 30 standalone real-life scenes for cafés, transport, shopping, travel, work, social visits, and everyday errands. Health scenes are language exercises and do not provide medical advice.

GUIDED PRACTICE
• Read Hindi in Devanagari with transliteration and an English meaning
• Choose a response and get immediate feedback
• Hear bundled Hindi lesson audio offline
• Save useful phrases for quick review
• Track your daily practice and streak on your device

OPTIONAL COACHING WITH ASHA
After a separate consent step, use AI Listen, type a message, start an Asha GPT-Live conversation, or record pronunciation. Choose a language-learning mode, then use Mute, Interrupt, or End Chat while speaking naturally. Generated AI voice and connected coaching require an internet connection.

YOUR CHOICE
The 102 short lessons and 30 standalone scenes, bundled lesson audio, saved phrases, and practice progress are available without an account or internet. AI features are optional, and consent can be withdrawn in Settings. AI replies can be reported from inside the app.

Bolo is a language-practice tool. AI responses may be inaccurate; do not rely on Bolo for professional translation, medical advice, or emergency help.
en-US.releaseNotes: Initial release with 102 short Hindi lessons in 11 guided plans, 30 standalone real-life scenes, bundled offline lesson audio, saved phrases, daily practice tracking, and optional typed, live voice, and pronunciation coaching with Asha.
en-US.promoText: Practice practical Hindi through 11 guided plans, 102 short lessons, and 30 standalone scenes, with optional coaching from Asha.

review.notes:
No account, login, purchase, or subscription is required. The 102 short lessons, 11 guided plans, and 30 standalone scenes work without connected coaching.

To review lesson audio, open a scene and tap Listen. The Hindi lesson line uses bundled offline audio; it does not require AI consent, a network connection, or a device text reader.

To review connected coaching, open Practice with Asha and accept AI data-use consent notice version 9 if needed. Keep English selected, type ‘How do I say thank you?’, and verify an English reply with generated AI voice playback. Select हिन्दी, type the same question, and verify a Hindi reply. Tap Start Conversation; this requests microphone permission and opens a full-duplex WebRTC media stream. Its microphone track stays enabled during the active chat so the learner can speak naturally or interrupt Asha; Mute disables it until unmuted. The stream and its tracks are released at End Chat, when leaving the screen, or when the app leaves the foreground. Live voice does not create a recording file or capture microphone audio in the background. A scene answer can be recorded for pronunciation feedback. Generated live and pronunciation replies include a Report control.

Settings allows consent withdrawal and deletion of local data plus server reports linked to the app's random identifier. Generated AI voice and connected coaching require internet access. Pharmacy and doctor scenes teach language phrasing and are not medical advice. Bolo does not record in the background.
